data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Maltese Capital Management's June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in ISTR and FRST.

ISTR's Q2 2026 total interest income was $53.2M versus $35.4M a year earlier, up 50.5% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1602658/000143774926026348/0001437749-26-026348-index.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records, including permits, agendas, call reports, and filings, with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
